title: Soudarion Cortege vs Alembic Brigade
lede:
The Alembic Brigade beat the Soudarion Cortege 33-25 on Victory Points at the end of Battle Round 6, scoring 11 VP in the last round after trailing 22-24.

The Cortege's LEAD FROM THE FRONT had reached its 10 VP cap in Round 5, so in Round 6 it scored nothing and paid the Brigade's STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION 2 VP, while the Brigade won the right objective on the unit-count tie-break and turned it into 5 VP with TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET.
result_line: Alembic Brigade win 33-25 on Victory Points in Battle Round 6
deployment: Central Faceoff on CROSSROADS, three objectives on row 7: the 3 VP centre at (7,7) and 2 VP flanks at (1,7) and (13,7). The Soudarion Cortege (250 RP) set up on rows 12 to 14 around its HQ at (7,13): Lazarite Prelate 1 leading Sepulchre Guard 1 at 9,12 and Lazarite Prelate 2 leading Sepulchre Guard 2 at 3,12, the three Covenant Levies in the middle at 6,12 to 8,12, Jordanite Hospitallers 1 and 2 at 4,12 and 11,12 for the flanks, the Staurotheke War-Shrine at 10,12 and the St. Barbara Field Gun at 4,14. The Alembic Brigade (248 RP) set up on rows 1 and 2 around its HQ at (7,1): Naqib 1 leading Muqatila Troopers 1 at 8,2, Naqib 2 leading Muqatila Troopers 2 at 3,2, the Rammal Geomancer leading Muqatila Troopers 3 at 5,2, Muqatila Troopers 4 at 10,2, the Abna al-Dawla Guard at 7,2, the Royal Alchemist at 11,2 and the two Carpet-Bombers behind at 5,1 and 3,1. Twelve units a side; the Cortege won the Roll Off for Priority. Both armies had their best melee squads in the centre and cheap units for the flanks: the Cortege's two 15 RP Hospitaller squads against the Brigade's 20-HP Muqatila Troopers and the Abna al-Dawla Guard.

feed.text: Primaries revealed: LEAD FROM THE FRONT for the Cortege, STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION for the Brigade. Secondaries kept: OMNIPRESENCE and BAR THE GATES. The Cortege spent all 3 CP on Covenant Levies 1: Double Time (2) and Scouting Order (1). The Brigade spent none; Matter Transmutation put Naft Pitch (ABLAZE) on Muqatila Troopers 4's Khanjar for 1 Al-Kimiya Ingredient.

Every unit Advanced. Covenant Levies 1 used the Double Time to reach 6,7, beside the centre; Muqatila Troopers 3 with the Rammal Geomancer rolled 6, 5, 5 and reached 8,6, with Muqatila Troopers 4 at 9,6 and the Carpet-Bombers (Sulayman's Wind) at 6,6 and 5,5. Jordanite Hospitallers 2 went 11,12 to 14,8, on the right objective; the Royal Alchemist rode to 12,6.
One attack all round: Carpet-Bomber 1's Drop-Bombs on Covenant Levies 1, two hits, both saved (Fortitude). Every other unit had no legal action.

The Brigade won the centre on OC 11 vs 10 (3 VP) and the Cortege the right on OC 3 vs 1 (2 VP). BAR THE GATES paid the Brigade 2 VP: no Cortege unit in its half. PRAYING gave the Cortege 11 Mana. 2-5.

2.title: Sepulchre Guard 1 wipes out Muqatila Troopers 4

feed.text: The Brigade spent 5 CP on Troop Requisition, a new Muqatila Troopers at 8,2, and coated Muqatila Troopers 1 with Zi'baq Beads (SUSTAINED ATTACK 1). The Cortege spent 2 CP on Double Time for Sepulchre Guard 1. New secondaries: BAR THE GATES for the Cortege, FOCUSED FIRE for the Brigade.

Both sides walked into each other's Overwatch: the Cortege's did 10 damage (Covenant Levies 1 put 5 into the new Muqatila Troopers with Providence, Covenant Levies 2 4 into Muqatila Troopers 4), the Brigade's 6. Then the charges: Muqatila Troopers 2 with Naqib 2 into Jordanite Hospitallers 1 at 0,8; the Abna al-Dawla Guard to 13,7 into Jordanite Hospitallers 2, which failed its Fall Back test, lost 2 HP and left the right objective for 13,11; Sepulchre Guard 1 with Lazarite Prelate 1 to 8,8 into Muqatila Troopers 4; Muqatila Troopers 3 with the Geomancer to 7,6 into Covenant Levies 1. Both Carpet-Bombers flew into the centre at 7,7 and 7,8.

Muqatila Troopers 3 hit Covenant Levies 1 for 4 and took 3 back. The Carpet-Bombers bombed Covenant Levies 2 for 3 and 4 (17 to 10). With Exaltation, Sepulchre Guard 1's War Hammers rolled 10 hits and destroyed Muqatila Troopers 4 (16 damage, 13 RP), taking ground at 8,7. Covenant Levies 3 and 2 shot Carpet-Bomber 2 down to 4 HP. On the left, Muqatila Troopers 2 and Naqib 2 destroyed Jordanite Hospitallers 1 (4 and 4); Retribution let the Hospitallers strike back for 1. Lazarite Prelate 2 spent 2 Mana on Introit, cast on the Cortege's own HQ. The Royal Alchemist channelled 5 Mana.

The Cortege took the centre on OC 20 vs 9 (3 VP) and LEAD FROM THE FRONT paid 3, counting Lazarite Prelate 1 and the Sepulchre Guard 1 it leads as two. The Brigade held the left on OC 11 vs 0 and the right on 5 vs 0 (4 VP), and STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION paid 1 for the Hospitallers destroyed in the left Objective Area. 8-10.

Benediction healed Jordanite Hospitallers 2 by 2, and the three Covenant Levies regenerated 2, 3 and 1 HP. The Brigade spent 2 CP on Double Time for Muqatila Troopers 2 and put Naft Pitch on Muqatila Troopers 1. New secondaries: IRON GRIP for the Cortege, IRON CURTAIN for the Brigade; FOCUSED FIRE expired.

The new Muqatila Troopers charged to 6,6 into Covenant Levies 1, and Muqatila Troopers 2 ran from 0,8 to 2,7 to charge Covenant Levies 3, which had moved to 3,7. Muqatila Troopers 3 failed its Fall Back test against Sepulchre Guard 1 (3 True Damage, one model) and went to 5,5. Covenant Levies 1 broke away to 8,8 through 4 damage of Abna al-Dawla Guard Overwatch. Sepulchre Guard 1 charged to 7,6 into the new Muqatila Troopers. The Abna al-Dawla Guard left the right objective for 10,6 and the Royal Alchemist walked back to 12,6, on it. The HQ, now with Introit's +2 MOVE, walked from 7,13 to 6,12.

Sepulchre Guard 1 and Lazarite Prelate 1 took the new Muqatila Troopers from 15 to 8. The Abna al-Dawla Guard shot Covenant Levies 1 for 6 and Carpet-Bomber 1 bombed it for 2 (14 to 6). Covenant Levies 3 attacked Muqatila Troopers 2 for 3 and took 8 back from Naqib 2 and the squad. The Rammal Geomancer spent 6 Mana on Samum at 7,7: Lazarite Prelate 1, Sepulchre Guard 1, Covenant Levies 1, the new Muqatila Troopers and both Carpet-Bombers BLINDED, OC 0 until the end of the next Battle Round. The Cortege used Go to Ground (1 CP) on Lazarite Prelate 2, and Lazarite Prelate 2 cast Introit on Sepulchre Guard 2 (2 Mana). The Royal Alchemist gathered 2 Al-Kimiya Ingredients.

Nobody scored the centre: the record says that without the Samum's BLINDED the Cortege would have held it. The Brigade held the left on OC 9 vs 0 and the right on 1 vs 0 with the Royal Alchemist alone (4 VP). LEAD FROM THE FRONT paid 3 for Lazarite Prelate 1 and Sepulchre Guard 1 in the enemy half. 11-14.

4.title: Level at 18 after Countercharge and Hospitallers' end

feed.text: The Cortege spent 5 CP: Troop Requisition (3), a new Covenant Levies at 10,12, and Double Time on Sepulchre Guard 2 (2). The Brigade put Red Sulfur (LETHAL, 3 Ingredients) on Muqatila Troopers 1 and spent 2 CP on a Rally Cry for the new Muqatila Troopers. New secondaries: STRONGPOINT for the Cortege, IRON GRIP for the Brigade. The Cortege's BAR THE GATES expired, and the Brigade's IRON CURTAIN completed as the Movement Phase began (+2 VP, +1 CP): no Brigade unit lost since Round 3.

Covenant Levies 3 failed its Fall Back test from Muqatila Troopers 2 (2 HP, one model) and went to 4,10; Covenant Levies 2 walked to 0,8, onto the left objective the Brigade had just left. The Abna al-Dawla Guard charged to 9,8 into Jordanite Hospitallers 2 and Covenant Levies 1; Covenant Levies 1 failed its test and broke away to 8,10. Naqib 2 spent 3 CP on a Countercharge that sent Muqatila Troopers 2 to 4,8 into Sepulchre Guard 2 and cancelled the Guard's charge. Sepulchre Guard 1 and Lazarite Prelate 1 walked out of the centre's area to 8,4, deeper into the enemy half.

Sepulchre Guard 2 and Lazarite Prelate 2 put 4 into Muqatila Troopers 2 (16 to 12). The Abna al-Dawla Guard destroyed Jordanite Hospitallers 2 (9, 15 RP). Covenant Levies 2 shot Carpet-Bomber 1 for 2. The Royal Alchemist's Samum at 6,8 (6 Mana) BLINDED Lazarite Prelate 2 and Sepulchre Guard 2 and bought nothing. The St. Barbara Field Gun fired at the Brigade's HQ, 12 squares away, and missed.

Covenant Levies 2 took the left on OC 7 vs 0 (2 VP) and completed IRON GRIP (2 VP, 1 CP); the Royal Alchemist kept the right on OC 1 vs 0 (2 VP). Nobody scored the centre. LEAD FROM THE FRONT paid 3 more (9 of 10). 18-18.

5.title: The Cortege leads, and its Primary is full

feed.text: Covenant Levies 3 regenerated 2. Each side spent 4 CP: the Cortege on Double Time for Sepulchre Guard 1 and a Rally Cry for Covenant Levies 1, the Brigade on Double Time for Muqatila Troopers 3 and a Rally Cry for the new Muqatila Troopers. Kahruba Charge (SHOCK) went on Muqatila Troopers 1. New secondaries: ASSASSINATION for the Cortege, COMMAND AUTHORITY for the Brigade; OMNIPRESENCE expired.

The new Covenant Levies charged the Royal Alchemist from 12,10 to 12,7, onto the right objective. Covenant Levies 3 walked into the centre at 6,8. Sepulchre Guard 1 and Lazarite Prelate 1 charged to 8,5 into Naqib 1, Muqatila Troopers 1, the Rammal Geomancer and Muqatila Troopers 3; Muqatila Troopers 1 failed its Fall Back test and went to 9,9. Muqatila Troopers 2 broke away from Sepulchre Guard 2 to 2,7, and the new Muqatila Troopers joined it on the left at 2,8. The Abna al-Dawla Guard went to 12,9.

Sepulchre Guard 1 put 7 into Muqatila Troopers 3 through the Geomancer (13 to 6) and Lazarite Prelate 1 2 more (6 to 4). Covenant Levies 2 shot Muqatila Troopers 2 for 4 (12 to 8). The Royal Alchemist attacked the new Covenant Levies and missed, and the Levies' counterattack took it to 3 of 5 HP. The St. Barbara Field Gun missed the Abna al-Dawla Guard.

The Cortege took the centre on OC 6 vs 3 and the right on 10 vs 1 (5 VP), but LEAD FROM THE FRONT paid only 1: it reached its 10 VP cap. The Brigade held the left on OC 8 vs 7 (2 VP) and completed IRON GRIP (2 VP, 1 CP). 24-22.

6.title: Eleven VP in the last round

feed.text: The Brigade kept TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET and the Cortege picked the objective for it: the right, at (13,7). The Brigade spent 3 CP on Double Time for the Abna al-Dawla Guard at 12,9, in the enemy half, which completed COMMAND AUTHORITY at once (+2 VP). The Cortege spent 2 CP on Double Time for Sepulchre Guard 1 and 2 on a Rally Cry for Covenant Levies 1, and kept DEEP REACH. Nushadir Salts (FROST) went on Muqatila Troopers 1.

Sepulchre Guard 2 and Lazarite Prelate 2 charged to 7,6 into the Geomancer and Muqatila Troopers 3 (Introit's response, +1 DMG); Muqatila Troopers 3 broke away to 9,9. Muqatila Troopers 1 and Naqib 1 charged from 9,9 to 7,7 into the Prelate, the Guard and Covenant Levies 3, which failed its test and fell back to 6,10. The Abna al-Dawla Guard charged to 13,8 into the new Covenant Levies on the right objective, and Muqatila Troopers 2 charged to 1,8 into Covenant Levies 2 on the left.

Sepulchre Guard 2 hit Muqatila Troopers 1 for 7 (19 to 12). The Abna al-Dawla Guard put 8 into the new Covenant Levies (20 to 12), and Naqib 2 and Muqatila Troopers 2 took Covenant Levies 2 from 13 to 4. Anointing of the Sick healed Sepulchre Guard 2 by 2. The St. Barbara Field Gun's shot into the melee on the right was resolved against the Cortege's own Covenant Levies (a Friendly Fire stray) and missed. The Rammal Geomancer's Samum at 6,6 (6 Mana) BLINDED both sides' units in the centre: Lazarite Prelate 2, Sepulchre Guard 2, Naqib 1 and Muqatila Troopers 1.

Nobody held the centre. The Brigade held the left on OC 8 vs 2 and won the right on OC 6 vs 6, on the tie-break of more units there (the Abna al-Dawla Guard and the Royal Alchemist against the Levies): 4 VP, then TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET 3 and STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION 2, because LEAD FROM THE FRONT, capped, scored nothing. The Cortege's only VP was STRONGPOINT (1). 25-33, past the 30 VP target.

analysis.title: Why it went this way
analysis.html:
Where the VP came from

The Alembic Brigade took 19 of its 33 VP from objectives: the left in Rounds 2, 3, 5 and 6 (8), the right in Rounds 2, 3, 4 and 6 (8), the centre in Round 1 (3). Its secondaries paid 11 (BAR THE GATES 2, IRON CURTAIN 2, IRON GRIP 2, COMMAND AUTHORITY 2, TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET 3) and STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION 3. The Soudarion Cortege scored 12 objective VP (the right in Rounds 1 and 5, the centre in Rounds 2 and 5, the left in Round 4), 10 from LEAD FROM THE FRONT (3, 3, 3 and 1) and 3 from secondaries (IRON GRIP 2, STRONGPOINT 1). The Primary was the Cortege's best source and also its ceiling: at 10 VP it stopped paying after Round 5, and a Primary that scores nothing is exactly what STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION pays 2 VP for. The Cortege's other cards failed: OMNIPRESENCE (2 OC on every objective) and BAR THE GATES were never on with the Brigade holding both flanks, and ASSASSINATION was not completed: the Royal Alchemist, a CHARACTER, sat on the right objective on 3 HP in Round 6, and the Cortege's one shot into that melee strayed onto its own Levies.

{{chart:objectives}}

What the key units did

For the Brigade, the Royal Alchemist and the Abna al-Dawla Guard each scored 6.5 VP. The Alchemist mostly by standing on the right objective (6 of its objective VP hinged on it, twice on OC 1 vs 0); the Guard did 27 damage, destroyed Jordanite Hospitallers 2 and won the right back in Round 6. Muqatila Troopers 2 with Naqib 2 held the left for most of the battle (5.0 and 3.0 VP, 26 damage between them) and destroyed Jordanite Hospitallers 1. The Rammal Geomancer's Round 3 Samum took the centre off the Cortege. Muqatila Troopers 1, the Marshal's bodyguard, carried five Matter Transmutation coatings (7 Al-Kimiya Ingredients), made two attacks and did no damage all battle.

For the Cortege, Sepulchre Guard 1 did the most damage on the table (28), destroyed Muqatila Troopers 4 in one charge and, with Lazarite Prelate 1, earned most of LEAD FROM THE FRONT (6.0 and 5.0 VP). Covenant Levies 2 scored 5.0 VP for 10 RP, the left objective and IRON GRIP in Round 4. The Staurotheke War-Shrine never had a legal action in six rounds, but its Crusade Eternal aura added 10.31 expected HP to 14 attacks. The St. Barbara Field Gun made five attacks and did no damage. The Cortege gained 30 Mana from PRAYING and spent 4, on two Introits.

{{chart:attrition}}

What the Cortege could not do

Hold the flanks. Its flank units were the two 15 RP Jordanite Hospitaller squads, and both were destroyed, in Rounds 2 and 4; after that the left and right were contested by Levies sent forward one at a time. Its two best units fought in the centre and beyond it: from Round 3 on, Sepulchre Guard 1 and Lazarite Prelate 1 stood in the enemy half, where they scored the Primary but no objective, and once the Primary was full in Round 5 that ground was worth nothing. The damage was even, 80 to 82, but the Brigade destroyed 30 RP to 13.

{{chart:rp-trade}}

The AI, not the army

  • The Cortege's five Double Times (10 CP: Covenant Levies 1 in Round 1, Sepulchre Guard 1 in Rounds 2, 5 and 6, Sepulchre Guard 2 in Round 4) all bought nothing, and so did the Round 1 Scouting Order: every move was in reach without them, and in Round 6 Sepulchre Guard 1 had no legal action at all.
  • Introit on the HQ (Round 2, 2 Mana): Lazarite Prelate 2 cast it on the Cortege's own HQ, a BASE and BUILDING, which then walked from 7,13 to 6,12, 6,10 and 5,11 (the passive record: HQ MOVE 2, 0 without the Antiphon). It gained nothing.
  • Matter Transmutation: after Round 1 the Brigade's AI put every coating on Muqatila Troopers 1, which made two attacks and did no damage; only Red Sulfur and Zi'baq Beads are priced at anything (0.52 and 0.04 expected HP).
  • Round 6, TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET: the Cortege's AI chose the right objective for the Brigade's card, where the Abna al-Dawla Guard and the Royal Alchemist stood beside a single Covenant Levies squad. The Brigade won it on the unit-count tie-break and scored 5 VP from it. Nobody held the centre that round, so naming the centre would have cost the Brigade the card's 3 VP, though 30 VP still reaches the target.
  • The Fall Back record is mostly real here: of 22 decisions only two (the Abna al-Dawla Guard and Covenant Levies 2 holding in Round 5, with the nearest engager 3 and 2 squares away) are charge-planning probes.

Partly the mission draw, partly the army: LEAD FROM THE FRONT handed the Cortege 9 VP in three rounds, then 1, then nothing, and its Hospitallers could not hold a flank against Muqatila Troopers. The Brigade's AI played the secondaries better, five completed to two, and the Cortege's AI gave it the last one.

closing_title: A full Primary is an empty one
closing: The Cortege led 24-22 with one round to go and a Primary that could pay no more. The Brigade's flank troops held the left, its Guard took the right on a tie-break, and three cards paid 7 VP in the last Cleanup.
